notes.title: Demo Update Patch Notes – [v D1.0]
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! Thank you all for playing the Continuum Keeper demo and sharing your feedback. Here’s a small update to address a few bugs and polish up the experience.[/p][h3]🔧 Fixes & Changes:[/h3][list][*][p] [b]Clock no longer flickers[/b] when switching between cameras.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Report Menu now has a cooldown[/b] to prevent accidental spam reports.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Fixed (hopefully!) the issue where reports failed to submit.[/b][/p][quote][p]If you still encounter this, please replicate it and send in a bug report![/p][/quote][/*][*][p] [b]Previous selections in the Report Menu now highlight[/b] when reporting.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Minor map tweaks and polish[/b] across both levels.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re continuing to improve based on your feedback. Thanks for playing, and keep watching the fractures! [/p][p]— SirPepperPot[/p]

notes.title: Training Manual Update – Now Live!
notes.content:
Greetings, Keepers!

A new update has just been deployed based on player feedback, and we’re excited to share what’s new:

• New Feature: Training Manual
A comprehensive in-game manual has been added to help new and returning recruits better understand their duties. This guide breaks down each type of Fracture you may encounter and provides visual and behavioral clues to help you identify them with confidence.

• Achievement Fixes
Several achievements that weren’t unlocking correctly have now been fixed. Your efforts will now be recognized properly—go claim what you’ve earned!

Your continued feedback helps shape the experience, and we’re grateful for everyone playing and supporting the game. More updates are in the works, so stay sharp out there.

Enjoying the game or looking forward to trying it?
Adding Continuum Keeper to your wishlist helps a ton and ensures you won’t miss future updates!

– SirPepperPot
